## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A write with the workstation AppRole succeeds for patch on...

The system SHALL ensure that a write with the workstation AppRole succeeds for patch on secret/data/newsletter and is denied for read and delete.

#### Scenario: A write with the workstation AppRole succeeds for patch on...

WHEN `ship-workstation-and-worker-approle-policies` is implemented
THEN A write with the workstation AppRole succeeds for patch on secret/data/newsletter and is denied for read and delete.

### Requirement: The worker AppRole succeeds for both read and patch on...

The system SHALL ensure that the worker AppRole succeeds for both read and patch on secret/data/newsletter and is denied for delete.

#### Scenario: The worker AppRole succeeds for both read and patch on...

WHEN `ship-workstation-and-worker-approle-policies` is implemented
THEN The worker AppRole succeeds for both read and patch on secret/data/newsletter and is denied for delete.

### Requirement: The seed script is idempotent and re-running it leaves both policies unchanged

The system SHALL ensure that the seed script is idempotent and re-running it leaves both policies unchanged.

#### Scenario: The seed script is idempotent and re-running it leaves both policies unchanged

WHEN `ship-workstation-and-worker-approle-policies` is implemented
THEN The seed script is idempotent and re-running it leaves both policies unchanged.
